title: Pullback chain maps preserving additive Cech augmentations
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $\iota$ a finite type, and $U_i\subset X$, $V_i\subset Y$ open families with inclusions $\bigcap_l V_{y(l)}\subset g^{-1}(\bigcap_l U_{y(l)})$ for every tuple $y$. Let $I,J$ be injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the lifted additive structure sheaves [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], and let $c_I,c_J$ be normalized comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Fix $n\geq0$. There exist cochain maps $f:G_I\to G_J$ and $t:T_{U,I}\to T_{V,J}$ between the global-section and Cech total complexes [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization] such that (1) $t^n\alpha_{U,n}=\alpha_{V,n}f^n$; (2) for any ordinary unit-module Cech cochains $x,x\prime$ [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] in degree $n$ whose tuple coordinates are structural pullbacks followed by the given tuple restrictions, $t^n\beta_{U,n}(x)=\beta_{V,n}(x\prime)$; and (3) for every global homology class $h$, $c_J(H^n(f)h)=H^n(q_g)(\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(g)(c_I(h)))$, where $q_g:g^{-1}A_X\to A_Y$ is adjoint to the structural additive coefficient map [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image,def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No prescribed cycles or equality of total homology classes are assumed, and no covering or affine hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Construct an augmented comparison α:I -> g_*J and its total map t by the augmented-transfer theorem. Take f to be its explicit globalResolutionSectionTransfer. The two component equations give alpha and beta compatibility. The canonical coefficient-transfer theorem computes H(f) in the supplied normalized comparisons, giving the final class equation.

proof_origin.place: Construct the augmented lift and total map; apply the proved canonical coefficient-transfer formula.

theorem exists_additiveCech_pullback_chain_transfer
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (J : InjectiveResolution Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (cI : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison X.etaleAdditiveSheaf I)
    (cJ : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf J)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : additiveCechGlobal I ⟶ additiveCechGlobal J,
    ∃ t : additiveCechTotal U I ⟶ additiveCechTotal V J,
      (additiveCechAlpha U I n ≫ t.f n = f.f n ≫ additiveCechAlpha V J n) ∧
      (∀ (x : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).X n)
        (x' : (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).X n),
        (∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ι,
            cechCoordinate Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) n y
                x' =
              (show Y.Modules from SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (hinter n y)).op
                ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app
                  (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))
                  (cechCoordinate X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) n y
                    x))) → t.f n (additiveCechBeta U I n x) = additiveCechBeta V J n x') ∧
      (∀ x, cJ.globalEquiv n (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f n x) =
        Sheaf.H.map
          (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction _ g).homEquiv _ _).symm
            (Scheme.etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar g)) n
          (Etale.cohomologyMap g X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n (cI.globalEquiv n x)))
